# Third-Party Gaussian Splat Scenes

Openly licensed 3DGS scene files for use as atmospheric backdrops in Fink.

## Scenes

| Folder | License | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `fountain-place-france/` | CC BY-SA 4.0 | Outdoor French town square with fountain |
| `fountain-sindelfingen/` | CC BY-SA 4.0 | Outdoor German town fountain |
| `observatory-soar/` | CC BY 4.0 | SOAR telescope, Chilean mountains |
| `observatory-rubin/` | CC BY 4.0 | Rubin telescope, Chilean mountains |
| `observatory-tololo/` | CC BY 4.0 | Tololo telescopes, Chilean mountains |
| `observatory-gemini-south/` | CC BY 4.0 | Gemini South telescope, Chilean mountains |

## Notes

- Fountain scenes via NVIDIA nvpro-samples, creator Christian Rochner / 3ds-scan.de
- Observatory scenes via github.com/khyron/Gaussian-Splatting
- CC BY-SA requires derivatives carry the same license
- CC BY requires attribution only
- The greenhouse scene (teleportour.com) was not downloaded pending license verification

## Not included (non-commercial only)

- INRIA pretrained scenes (bicycle, garden, stump, etc.) — research use only
- Mip-NeRF 360 dataset — non-commercial only
- Tanks & Temples — non-commercial only
